preconditions.description: The number of balls n is between 2 and 200,000 inclusive.
The number of swaps m is between 1 and 200,000 inclusive.
The initial position of the special ball k is between 1 and n inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x_i <= n and 1 <= y_i <= n and x_i != y_i for x_i, y_i in swaps)
preconditions.description: Each swap is between two distinct positions x_i and y_i, both between 1 and n inclusive.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly n integers.

postconditions.expression: all(result[i] >= -1 and result[i] <= m for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: Each integer in the output is between -1 and m inclusive.
The minimum number of swaps to get the special ball to its initial position is 0.

postconditions.expression: all(result[i] == -1 or (result[i] >= 0 and result[i] <= m) for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: If the special ball can be moved to position i, the number of swaps is between 0 and m inclusive; otherwise, it is -1.
